hackUMBC 2026 · UMBC alumni data

What makes a student successful?

“Success” means something different to different people. Here, we use salary as the measure of success and look at how much of the variation in alumni salaries each factor explains.

See the findings Browse the datasets
2%Salary variance explained by major
20%…by first job family
16%…by first employer industry
9.8%Alumni still seeking work
From the dashboard

Major findings

Salary is our measure of success. Each group below tests one factor against it.

Majors and their effect on success

Correlation between major (IS = 1) and starting salary: −0.135. Squared, that is 0.018: only about 2% of the variation in starting salary is explained by major.

Method

How we work

Every finding goes through the same five steps. The analysis code lives in analysis.py and the dashboard in app.py.

  1. 01

    Load

    Six CSV files from the hackUMBC 2026 dataset, joined on each person's campus ID.

    pandas · read_csv
  2. 02

    Clean

    Turn "Not Applicable" into missing values, convert salaries to numbers, count repeat activities once per person.

    pandas
  3. 03

    Explore

    Box plots, hiring curves, and salary trends, one notebook cell per question.

    Jupyter · matplotlib
  4. 04

    Measure

    Variance explained by each factor, and salary compared with peers who have the same years of experience.

    η² (ANOVA) · numpy
  5. 05

    Share

    Package every chart as a function and serve them in an interactive dashboard.

    Streamlit
